# rewriteFixedPoint rewrites the original graph twice when the size
# changes. Here each rewrite deduplicates two classes with 600 names each,
# so both draw a random name (TooManyTypeNames) from the global generator;
# the second draw is wasted but shifts the name CombineClasses draws next.
builder
prim i integer
str s unrestricted
ucls a open x:i many=a:600
ucls b open x:i many=b:600
ucls c open p:i,q:i,r:i,s1:s many=c:600
ucls d open p:i,q:i,r:i,s2:s many=d:600
cls top a:a,b:b,c:c,d:d n=Top
top Top top
finish
fixedpoint
print
combine conflate
gc
print
